hero.subtitle: Read mail as conversations, organize it on a board, and keep every account together. Free, open source, and stored on your device.
features.title: Less sorting. More getting things done.
features.subtitle: Follow the conversation, see what needs your attention, and keep your day moving.
features.inbox.title: Email that reads like a conversation
features.inbox.body: Bring your accounts together and read each thread as a flowing conversation. Keep a reply open while you check another message, without losing your place.
features.inbox.point1: One inbox for your IMAP and Gmail accounts
features.inbox.point2: Open conversations in tabs or separate windows
features.inbox.alt: Meron conversation view with browser-style tabs and detached window menu
features.kanban.title: Turn your inbox into a visual workflow
features.kanban.body: Give your inbox a sense of direction. Group messages by project or next step, then move them across your board as work progresses.
features.kanban.point1: Keep work moving with saved searches and tags
features.kanban.point2: Drag messages between columns to update their tags
features.kanban.alt: Meron Kanban board with Inbox, To do, and Review tag columns
features.rules.title: Let rules handle the routine
features.rules.body: Sort incoming mail and organize what you send automatically. Move receipts into a folder, tag project updates, or clear one-time codes after you’ve read them.
features.rules.point1: Rules for Inbox and Mail I send (tag, star, copy, move)
features.rules.point2: Delayed timers: auto-trash 2FA codes 5 min after reading
features.rules.alt: Meron rule editor configured for Mail I send with tags, starring, and folder copy
features.calendar.title: Keep your schedule beside your inbox
features.calendar.body: Respond to invitations without leaving the conversation. See upcoming events and tasks alongside your mail, with reminders to help you stay on track.
features.calendar.point1: Interactive invite cards directly inside conversations
features.calendar.point2: Dockable side panel with mini month & 7-day agenda
features.calendar.alt: Meron Kanban board alongside the Calendar side panel showing mini month grid and 7-day agenda
bento.title: Find what you need. Keep what matters.
bento.subtitle: The people, files, and messages you come back to, ready when you need them.
bento.contacts.title: Remember the person behind the email
bento.contacts.body: Keep frequent contacts close, add private notes, and pick up where your last conversation left off.
bento.contacts.alt: Contacts side panel with private Markdown notes and conversation history
bento.gallery.title: Find the file without the hunt
bento.gallery.body: Browse a thread’s photos and documents in one visual gallery, without digging through every reply.
bento.localFolders.title: Make room without losing your mail
bento.localFolders.body: Archive older messages on your device and keep an encrypted backup you can restore when you need it.
bento.localFolders.alt: Settings Local Folders storage usage and encrypted backup controls
bento.composer.title: A composer that keeps up with you
bento.composer.body: Drop the signature on a quick reply, paste a whole recipient list from a spreadsheet, and add links without leaving the keyboard.
bento.composer.alt: Meron composer with signature toggle and clickable links
themes.title: Make it feel like yours
themes.body: Choose a light or dark palette that feels right, or create your own. Try the themes below to find your favorite.
security.title: Keep private conversations private
security.body: Send and receive end-to-end encrypted email with OpenPGP. Create a key or bring your own, and keep sensitive conversations between you and your recipients.
security.card1Title: Keys that work with your contacts
security.card1Body: Exchange keys automatically with Autocrypt, or import keys you already use.
security.card2Body: Your local mail database is encrypted. We don’t store your messages on our servers.
security.alt: OpenPGP encryption and key discovery settings in Meron
openSource.title: Your mail stays yours
openSource.body: Meron is local-first: your messages stay on your device, not on our servers. The full source is released under the AGPL-3.0 license, so you can read it, audit it, and build on it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Meron accesses, uses, stores, and shares Gmail and Google Calendar data, and how you can delete local copies and revoke access.
privacy.intro: Nonbili Inc. operates Meron, an email and calendar app that runs on your device. Meron connects directly to the providers you choose. Nonbili does not receive or store your synced messages or calendar events on its servers as part of normal app use.
privacy.googleData.title: Google data Meron accesses and uses
privacy.googleData.accountBody: Meron uses your Google Account email address to identify the account you connect. During Gmail setup, it can also use your Google profile name and picture to display the account in Meron.
privacy.googleData.gmailBody: When you connect Gmail, Meron requests the Gmail mail scope ({scope}) for IMAP and SMTP access. It reads mailbox folders and labels, message headers, sender and recipient addresses, message bodies, attachments, and read or starred status. Meron uses this data to display and search mail, find correspondents, and organize messages in your inbox and Kanban boards. Meron sends messages on your behalf and syncs changes such as moving, marking, archiving, or deleting mail. Mail rules you set up can perform the actions you configure.
privacy.googleData.calendarBody: On desktop, Meron asks for the Calendar scope ({scope}) when you choose to connect Google Calendar. You can connect it separately in Settings or during the optional step after Gmail setup. Meron uses CalDAV to read the name of your primary calendar and its events, including titles, dates and times, time zones, recurrence, locations, descriptions, organizers, attendees, and reminders where present. It displays events and supports local reminders. When you create, edit, or delete an event in this calendar in Meron, the app sends that change to Google. Changes made in Google Calendar are synced back to Meron.
privacy.storage.title: Storage and security
privacy.storage.body: Meron uses encrypted connections to Google for authorization, mail, and calendar sync. Meron stores synced messages, attachments, calendar events, search indexes, and preferences on your device so that you can browse and search downloaded data offline. Meron keeps OAuth tokens for reconnecting to Google and refreshing access. On desktop, it stores tokens in the operating system's credential store. On mobile, it keeps account data in the app's local storage.
privacy.recipients.title: Who receives data
privacy.recipients.item1: Meron communicates with Google to sign in and sync. When you send a message, Google delivers the content and attachments to the recipients you select. When you edit a calendar event, Google receives the change and may make it visible to attendees and others according to your calendar's sharing settings.
privacy.recipients.item2: If you export data or make a backup, the copy goes to the location you select. If you enable remote images in an email, the app may contact the server that hosts those images.
privacy.recipients.item3: On desktop, you can enable optional local MCP access and authorize another application to read mail from the accounts you select or perform actions you allow. MCP access is off by default. An approved application may process data outside your device under its own privacy policy. You can revoke its access in Meron's MCP settings.
privacy.recipients.item4: If you contact Nonbili for support, we receive the details you choose to share, such as your email and any diagnostic logs you attach. We use them to respond to your request.
privacy.recipients.outro: Nonbili uses Google user data to provide or improve the user-facing features described here. Nonbili does not sell Google user data, use it for advertising or commercial tracking, or use it to train general-purpose AI or machine learning models.
privacy.limitedUse.title: Google API Services Limited Use
privacy.limitedUse.body: Meron's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the {policyLink}, including the {limitedUse} requirements.
privacy.limitedUse.policyLink: Google API Services User Data Policy
privacy.retention.title: Retention, deletion, and revoking access
privacy.retention.body1: Meron keeps synced Google data on your device while the corresponding account is connected so that it remains available between syncs. Remove your Gmail account in Meron's account settings to stop mail sync and remove the account's saved credentials and cached mail. Remove your Google Calendar account in Settings → Calendars to stop calendar sync and remove its saved credentials and cached events. Removing either account in Meron leaves the original data in your Google Account.
privacy.retention.body2: Copies you saved in exports, backups, or a local mail archive may remain until you delete those copies separately. You can also revoke Meron's authorization in {permissionsLink}. To remove both access and the on-device cache, revoke the grant in Google and remove the corresponding account in Meron.
privacy.changes.title: Changes and contact
privacy.changes.body1: We publish updates to this policy on this page and update the date above. If we change how we use Google user data, we will notify affected users and ask for their consent before using the data in the new way.
privacy.changes.body2: For privacy questions or requests about data you have shared with Nonbili, contact {emailLink}.
